notes: 'config'/'appConfig' mirror the source file's makeConfig()/makeAppConfig() test helpers and their defaults (paperJarPath "server.jar", minRamGB 1, maxRamGB 2, serverDir "/srv/mc"; javaPath "java", extraFlags ""), overridden per-fixture exactly as each Swift test overrides them. Note maxRamGB here (4) differs from config's own default maxRamGB (2) — javaScript()'s explicit minRamGB/maxRamGB params are what's actually used for flags, not config.minRamGB/maxRamGB (see ram-flags-match-sheet-values below, which tests this distinction directly). Fabric, like Paper, uses a plain jar launch (its 'paperJarPath' field holds fabric-server-launch.jar here — the field is reused across flavors, not Paper-specific despite the name).
